name: API Orchestrator - Sample: Magento
description: Magento 2 GraphQL sample with ten pre-configured endpoints (products, categories, CMS, utilities).
project_description: API Orchestrator - Sample: Magento installs a Magento 2 GraphQL sample integration — an api_orchestrator_service plus ten pre-configured GraphQL endpoints covering products, categories, CMS and utility queries — to demonstrate GraphQL usage and token/variable handling. Point the service base URL at your Magento GraphQL endpoint. Requires api_orchestrator, api_orchestrator_integration_samples and api_orchestrator_mirror. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
